messages:
incident-bot: Paging: SEV2 — inference-serving error-rate > 0.8% (rolling 5m) for prod cluster. linked: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/serving-alerts
Alex: ack — I'm oncall. seeing a spike in model_rpc_error_count across pool-gpu-a. first thing: is this traffic pattern or model-side?
Marta: I'm joining. looks correlated with a sudden increase in ‘priority-routing’ traffic from the sandbox tenant (odd). can someone post the quick metrics?
Ryan: past 20m: model_rpc_error_count jumped from ~5/min to ~120/min. p95 latency also climbed from 120ms -> 420ms. queue_depth for pool-gpu-a spiked to ~85%.
Samir: app logs show a heap of 503s from the model-backend, plus grpc Unavailable in the tail. might be a model worker OOM pattern.
Alex: mitigation path: 1) remove sandbox tenant from priority routing (route to best-effort) 2) scale a burst pool (dedicated burst nodes) 3) mute noisy alerting rule while we stabilize. thoughts?
Marta: agree. I'll flip routing to best-effort now. Alex, can you open a short-term scaleup? If we scale it should auto-warm KV cache otherwise latency will be worse.
Alex: done: routed sandbox->best-effort (policy id: rp-493). also triggered scale-up: +2 n1-gpu workers to pool-gpu-a via infrabot.
incident-bot: Deploy action accepted: scale-up job 6321 queued -> executing.
Ryan: after routing change error rates dropped ~70% in 6m. p95 still elevated; queue_depth down to ~30%. sounds like tail workers recovering.
Samir: I recommend we mute the "inference-serving-error-rate" alert for prod for 30m to avoid noise during warmup. we should not blind ourselves though — create a temporary alert with higher threshold for oncall.
Elaine: filing that now. creating new alert: inference-serving-error-rate-temp with threshold 2% and longer evaluation 10m. will post rule id.
Elaine: rule created: rule-881-temp. Muting original rule in alertmanager for 30m.
Alex: good. next: post-incident we need an incident retrospection dashboard that makes the causal chain obvious: upstream request rate -> routing policy changes -> queue depth -> model RPC errors -> p95/p99 latency -> fallback rate. current dashboard is missing a couple panels for routing and KV cache warmup.
Marta: +1. propose a new grafana dashboard folder: /dashboards/incident-retrospectives/serving-golden-signals. panels: (a) request rate by tenant & routing-policy (b) queue depth and worker utilization (c) p50/p95/p99 latencies by model variant (d) model_rpc_error_count classified by error type (e) fallback/reroute counts and which policy triggered (f) KV cache hit ratio and cold-start timers (g) correlation heatmap of request size vs latency.
Samir: include a drilldown panel that links each error spike to recent deploys and rollouts. add a panel for "routing decisions" logs (sample recent routing decisions from our router stream).
Ryan: here's a couple prom queries to use (paste into new panels):
```
# p95 latency per model variant
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_variant))
# rpc error rate
sum(rate(model_rpc_error_count[5m])) by (error_type) / sum(rate(inference_requests_total[5m]))
# queue depth per pool
max_over_time(worker_queue_depth{pool=~"pool-gpu.*"}[5m])
```
Marta: for the KV cache panel use: cache_hits / (cache_hits + cache_misses) and add an annotation for when workers are scaled. also recommend a short note in the dashboard readme about expected warmup windows: (15m for first warmers, 3-5m for subsequent).
Alex: tagging this as an oncall -> retro handoff. action items: 
- Alex: Add initial draft dashboard (create panels + queries) and add to dashboards/incident-retrospectives.
- Marta: Write the retro note with timeline and correlate with tenant routing change.
- Samir: Propose alert tuning PR: change original error-rate rule to 0.9% with 10m eval and add secondary rule for bursty tenants.
- Elaine: runbook update: add steps for routing quick-mitigation and guidance for muting alerts safely.
Elaine: creating the ticket in #incidents with epic link: INC-4209, will attach graphs and timeline.
Samir: quick note — when we build the dashboard, add a panel showing the version/hash of model loaded on each worker (helps spot mismatches).
Ryan: thanks everyone. for transparency I'll leave the temp alert in place until 30m after last error drop. looks like we avoided customer-impact; marking as SEV2 -> SEV3? wait — actually impact: minor degradation to a small sandbox tenant only. changing severity to SEV3 (no externally visible customer errors).
Alex: closing the paging state; please follow up on PRs. I'll push the initial grafana draft in ~45m. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity updated to SEV3, incident id INC-4209, retrospective dashboard pending.
Marta: noting for retro: consider adding an automated router-safety throttle to protect production pools from misconfigured tenants. will add to backlog. :memo:
Samir: thanks — will open the alerting PR after the dashboard draft.
Alex: good job team.
